## Recommendations

### Top Pick for AI & Camera: Google Pixel 8a

The Pixel 8a is the strongest choice for your specific needs. Its Tensor G3 chip is custom-built for Google's on-device AI, directly supporting features like AI-powered notes. It also has the highest resolution main camera and an unmatched **7-year software update promise**, ensuring long-term security and feature availability.

### Best for Raw Performance: OnePlus 13R
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/speedometer2.svg
If raw processing power is a priority for heavy multitasking or gaming alongside AI tasks, the OnePlus 13R is the clear winner. Its flagship-grade Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processor and 12 GB of RAM offer the most performance, though it comes at the highest price in this group.

### Best Value Hardware: Nothing Phone 3a Pro
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/gem.svg
